title: Sloppy Joe Grilled Cheese
description: A delicious combination of sloppy joe filling and grilled cheese sandwich.
steps: Brown the hamburger meat and diced onions in a skillet.
Add beef bouillon powder and mix with the meat, then let it finish browning.
Add minced garlic and cook for 30 to 45 seconds.
Stir in tomato sauce, ketchup, mustard, salt, black pepper, and brown sugar. Cook on low heat.
In a separate hot skillet, toast the Texas toast with a little mayonnaise on each side.
Place slices of cheese on the toasted bread.
Add the sloppy joe meat on top of the cheese.
Finish cooking like a grilled cheese sandwich until the bread is toasted and the cheese is melted.
